adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking.ts` collects additional team member destination calendars and does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. However, when persisting the booking it only stores a single relation: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (so the extra calendars are not persisted). Later flows that recreate `CalendarEvent` from the stored booking—e.g. `confirm.handler.ts`, `payments/api/webhook.ts`, and `paypal-webhook.ts`—wrap the single `booking.destinationCalendar` into an array (`[booking.destinationCalendar]`), so they can only ever act on that one stored calendar. This means collective/multi-host destination calendars are effectively lost for confirmation/payment-triggered event creation paths shown in the diff.
